## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Mixed and vulnerable to rotation: NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -0.64%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.54%), META CORRECTION (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +3.08%); sector 1W: -0.85% (19 stocks) — watch for further dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Mixed / corrective: multiple banks showing CORRECTION despite positive 1M: C CORRECTION (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%), GS CORRECTION (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%), JPM CORRECTION (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%); sector 1W: -1.61% (20 stocks) — look for stabilization before re-engaging.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive anchors but mixed internals: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +0.78%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +2.82%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +1.59%), CVS ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +0.33%); sector 1W: -0.20% (15 stocks) — relative stability vs cyclical swings.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Stay neutral and selective: favor Communication names and select Energy/defensive Healthcare that are ABOVE TREND (e.g., CMCSA, UNH, XOM) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech currently BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Major-cap divergence argues for position trimming and monitoring for trend confirmation rather than broad redeployment.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NKE RECOVERY (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%), CMCSA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%). BEARISH: TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +4.55%), C CORRECTION (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.09%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Communication (positive this week; sector: 7 stocks; 1W: +1.50%), Energy (1W: +0.71%; 8 stocks) for tactical gains. BEARISH: Financials and Technology (both 1W negative; Financials 20 stocks, Technology 19 stocks) — watch for continuation of CORRECTION patterns.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch for AAPL to reclaim sustained weekly gains to exit BELOW TREND; NVDA needs follow-through to stop the CORRECTION and resume above-month trend; JPM/GS stabilization above short-term pivots would remove bank-led downside pressure; NKE follow-through above recent highs would confirm the RECOVERY as more than a one-week bounce.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

NKE (+50): insider buying headline; price RECOVERY (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%) — sentiment confirmed by strong 1W move. TMUS (+50): upgrade on subscriber outlook; price RECOVERY (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) — positive but short-term. CVS (+50): higher target from Bernstein; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +0.33%) — sentiment confirmed. CAT (+50): target raise; price CORRECTION (1W: -1.64% | 1M: +0.85%) — sentiment diverging from 1W weakness. AMZN (+45): constructive analyst notes; price BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.31%) — monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (-50): negative outlook headline in news feed (price data not shown in this extract). INTC (-50): headline around competitive pressure (price data not shown in this extract). ORCL (-40): headline noting risk around AI tie (price data not shown in this extract). Cross-check with price needed from full feed before tactical moves.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (mixed / no clear leadership).  
Communication and select Energy/Healthcare names are showing relative strength (CMCSA ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: major-cap divergence (multiple big caps in CORRECTION vs RECOVERY) and patchy sentiment (some bullish headlines confirming rallies while others diverge) — watch for trend confirmation.
